method: force each candidate token with a known logit bias, then algebraically remove the bias
result: No usable bias range exists for every candidate token in the calibration rows. At lower bias some extremely unlikely candidate tokens are not forced; at higher bias llama.cpp returns a saturated probability of 1.0, which erases the information required to recover the original likelihood.
decision: Do not use first-token scoring (53.44% of roster candidates collide on their first token) and do not report full-sequence likelihood from this endpoint build. Evidence-constrained generation was run instead.
